compound qualifying the nectar as having the essence of desire-art

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: The nectar is identified as the true nature of Kaula.
This nectar is characterized as having the essence of desire-art.
The listener is commanded to hear about this nectar.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is the true nature of Kaula, essentially constituted by the art of desire.
uncertainties: The precise technical meaning of kāmakalā in this context may vary across traditions.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true nature of Kaula, whose essence is the art of desire.
